name: Audible
description: Audible is Amazon's audiobook service; India operations (paid Audible India launched 2018, Audible Suno 2019) run within Amazon's broader corporate structure with no distinct, disclosed India MCA-filing entity for the audiobook business specifically.

stock.note: No standalone Audible entity; reflects parent Amazon.com Inc (NASDAQ: AMZN) ~$262.07 (Aug 25, 2026), not Audible specifically.

marketing_spend.derivation: No India entity, no PMAR entry, and no disclosed India revenue base, so Tiers 1-3 don't apply. Audible is a modest player within India's small audio-content ad category, with campaign presence in ad-trade press low relative to Spotify/Pocket FM/Kuku FM. Triangulated at ~₹15-40 crore/year — the lowest-confidence estimate in this portfolio.
